name: Ajax AutoSearch
author: Catch Plugins

sections.description: Ajax AutoSearch is a free WordPress Search Plugin that enhances the Search feature on your site. The plugin provides a handful of crucial customization options with which you have full control over the search results. Ajax AutoSearch includes features like Different Search Filters, Display Featured Image, Post Limit, and more. To make things easier for your visitors, you can display the search filter options like post, page, categories, and tags. Your visitors can choose the search content type they are searching for and get the adequate results in just a few seconds with the search filters option available. You can also choose to display the featured images of the search results. Ajax AutoSearch allows you to display up to 20 search results on a single page. The plugin is extremely lightweight and comes with only the essential configuration options. So, improve the search results for your visitors with Ajax AutoSearch. A quick solution for better user experience should always be a priority for all webmasters.
sections.installation:
The easy way (via Dashboard) :

  • Go to Plugins > Add New
  • Type in the Ajax AutoSearch in Search Plugins box
  • Click Install Now to install the plugin
  • After Installation click activate to start using the Ajax AutoSearch
  • Go to Ajax AutoSearch from Dashboard menu

Not so easy way (via FTP) :

  • Download the Ajax AutoSearch
  • Unarchive Ajax AutoSearch plugin
  • Copy folder with ajax-autosearch.zip
  • Open the ftp \wp-content\plugins\
  • Paste the plug-ins folder in the folder
  • Go to admin panel => open item “Plugins” => activate Ajax AutoSearch
  • Go to Ajax AutoSearch from Dashboard menu
